forbiddenActions: stage files without explicit human approval
commit files without explicit human approval
print secrets or raw private configuration

repositoryCondition.summary: SEIS AI Core has fixture-backed contracts and is ready for read-only local repository assistance. The assistant may summarize branch state, changed paths, validation status, risks, and next safe action from local evidence only.

evidence.summary: Repository Assistant policy defines allowed context, forbidden context, read-only tools, forbidden tools, and output format.
Model-router and provider policy keep repository review local-only until provider routing is explicitly approved.
Prompt regression fixtures include a repository-assistant read-only scenario with blocked write actions and evidence requirements.
AI Core and Command Center shared contract exposes model routes, prompt versions, repository intelligence, audits, and evaluation state.

risks.summary: Repository assistance must not become a hidden write-capable agent. GitHub writes, provider routing, SSH, deployment, and destructive cleanup remain outside this prototype.
Validation summaries must name commands actually run and must not imply benchmark, training, deployment, or provider readiness.

validationStatus.summary: Validates the fixture shape, source links, read-only mode, forbidden actions, non-claims, and secret/path hygiene.
Keeps the repository-assistant prompt regression scenario aligned with read-only behavior.

recommendedBranchPlan.summary: Continue in a short-lived review branch, commit local-only repository assistant evidence as a small slice, and open a human-reviewed PR before any merge.

nextSafeAction.summary: Use the local prototype output to render or review repository state in Command Center, then add evaluation report generation for prompt and app-state fixtures.

nonClaims: No external provider routing is enabled.
No GitHub write action is enabled.
No SSH, deployment, or infrastructure mutation is enabled.
No model training, benchmark, or SEIS-owned model claim is created.
No secret values or raw private configuration are included.
